title: Kilts, Castles and Kissing My Ex
author: Robin Hartes
short_description: One Highland castle wedding. One cherry-red hire car. One ex-boyfriend named as the other driver.
synopsis:
Theo Ashworth has a list. Be happy for Kirsty. No whisky before the speeches. Do not open the email. Be normal about Rory.

His best friend is getting married at Castle Dunmorach on the Cromarty Firth. A studio in Berlin wants an answer about the job of a lifetime by five o'clock on Friday. And the other named driver on the cherry-red Fiat that Theo is supposed to deliver to the wedding is Ruaraidh Macleod: joiner, crofter's son, and the man whose handwriting was on the shopping lists on their fridge for five years.

Three years ago they went in different directions, Theo to London and Rory home to the croft, and neither of them ever quite said why. Now there's a ceilidh, a castle, a lot of rain and a car that has to be back at the depot by ten o'clock sharp, and two people who can't keep pretending they're over each other.

A warm, funny, second-chance romance about going home, going away, and finally saying the thing out loud.
